resource.label: Tenebrium
resource.lore: Black-hole distillate metal from BAR lore. Scarce since the Generic Disaster. In Verdance, every unit with build power costs ≥1 Tnb (ceil(buildSpeed/150)); that stake lives on the unit and survives as wreck/heap/debris until reclaimed or truly vaporized. Infinite storage (display number). Q7 is the scarcity qubit. Armada spent their entire stock on a continent of farming decoy commanders (wind/solar/converter farms) — crisis, bank 0.

credits.label: Scrap Credits
credits.notes: Broker scrip for pure combat packages. Not a substitute for Tenebrium on build gear.

punch_of_thugs.label: Punch of Thugs
punch_of_thugs.blurb: Broker loan: a smoking pack of Cortex Thugs (corthud). You start the campaign with them. Return them healthier than you took them — they soak early repair downtime on purpose.

crash_of_brutes.label: Crash of Brutes
crash_of_brutes.blurb: Buy a short column of Cortex Brutes (corraid) for a hammer push. Paid in scrap credits; no Tenebrium — they do not build.

cortex_grunt_fab.label: Cortex Grunt Fab (locked)
cortex_grunt_fab.blurb: A little Cortex bot lab locked to print Grunts (corak) on repeat. Arc 1 chaff stream for the mercenary band. Arc 2 can bolt on build power.

grunt_fab_build_power.label: Grunt Fab Build Power
grunt_fab_build_power.blurb: Arc 2+: park nanos on the locked fab and thicken the metal/energy trickle so the grunt stream keeps up with tempo missions.

armada_constructor.label: Armada Constructor
armada_constructor.blurb: High Armada reputation opens their construction bots for hire. Costs Tenebrium — you are buying the right to *build*.

cortex_constructor.label: Cortex Constructor
cortex_constructor.blurb: High Cortex reputation opens their construction bots for hire. Costs Tenebrium.

wheelie_tech_spoke.label: Contract: Spoke (Wheelie Tech)
wheelie_tech_spoke.blurb: Null Merc scout specialist. Spoke rides a Wheelie and banks XP from every scout that dies — new Wheelies mint with that floor. Not a default ace; unlocks when the bay trusts you.

tenebriumOnZoneFlip.notes: No free Tnb mint on node claim / zone flip. Liquid Tnb only via reclaim or rare victory scavenge.
